title: Account access and account details
required_reference_topics: Approved recovery and account-change branches with interpretation limits.
Independent account-state/action records and supported recovery instructions.

check_conditions.procedure.information: Distinguish username recovery, password reset, lost-phone access and account-address changes. Establish only the identity prerequisites required by the eligible recovery/change branch; a supplied name is not successful verification.
check_conditions.procedure.actions: Distinguish username recovery, password reset, lost-phone access and account-address changes. Perform the authorised recovery or account change with correct target/details; never infer permission to bypass identity checks. Compare the recorded agreed operation here; required verification/eligibility/permission relationships remain in procedure.order_permission, and factual policy claims require independent eligible support in Answer support.
check_conditions.procedure.order_permission: Establish only the identity prerequisites required by the eligible recovery/change branch; a supplied name is not successful verification. Use the required validation-before-change relationships and honour current permission and corrections.
check_conditions.completeness: Identify the actual access problem and any supported address correction. Address requested username, password, access or address help separately; do not activate an explicitly deferred request.
check_conditions.completeness.promises_next_steps: Account for recovery/change completion, an explained eligible limit or a pending step. Explain customer login/reset/change steps and any actual remaining obligation.
check_conditions.communication-style: Clearly distinguish usernames, passwords, links and old versus new account details.
check_conditions.answer-support: Eligible recovery guidance and authoritative account/reset/update records; never the Agent assertion alone.

additional_interpretation_limits: Do not infer authority to bypass verification, collect unnecessary secrets or change security settings from an ambiguous guideline.
